plan.text: Your week Draft: this plan has not been tried by a learner. Minutes are targets, not measurements. Every link goes to an existing screen. This is a pacing guide: the Today card on Home moves to the next lesson as soon as you mark one complete, so it can run ahead of this plan. Follow the Today card. 10 minutes a day, about 135 minutes this week. Lessons start at r01. Day 1 (30 min) Your first 10 minutes 10 min Shin and Bet: your first two letters 20 min Day 2 (20 min) Tav and the dot in Bet: Shabbat 20 min Day 3 (25 min) Lamed, final Mem and Vav: Shalom 25 min Day 4 (15 min) Shabbat Shalom: review 15 min Day 5 (15 min) Meet the Priestly Blessing (listen and spot) 15 min Day 6 (20 min) Yod and the 'ee' vowel 20 min Day 7 (10 min) Review due cards 5 min Trace letters 5 min
